title: CWP/17367/2025 of PREM SINGH Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS
text: Sr. No.123 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH CWP-17367 of 2025 (O&M) Date of Decision : 01.07.2025 Prem Singh …Petitioner Versus State of Haryana and others …Respondents CORAM : HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPAK SIBAL HON’BLE MS. JUSTICE LAPITA BANERJI Present : Mr. Ajay Jain, Advocate, for the petitioner. Mr. P.P.Chahar, Sr. DAG, Haryana for respondents No.1 to 3. Mr. Randhir Singh, Advocate, for respondent No.4-Gram Panchayat. DEEPAK SIBAL, J. (Oral) Learned counsel for the parties are in agreement that the present petition be disposed of in terms of order of even date passed in CWP-17362 of 2025 “Karan alias Dhanpat Vs. State of Haryana and others.” In view of the above, the present petition is also disposed of in terms of Karan alias Dhanpat’s case (supra). (DEEPAK SIBAL) JUDGE (LAPITA BANERJI) JUDGE July 01, 2025 vandana

obligations.text: disposed of in terms of order of even date passed in CWP-17362 of 2025
